jobs.title: Chef de Partie - Gardemanger (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Chef de Partie - Gardemanger (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Start: 2026-10-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## Your mission:
To strengthen our kitchen team, we are looking for a passionate Chef de Partie – Gardemanger (f/m/d) who delivers top quality to the plate with passion, precision, and a flair for cold culinary artistry.
• Section Ownership: You lead the gardemanger section independently, preparing exquisite cold starters, salads, creative carpaccios, tartares, terrines, and sophisticated canapés to the highest standard (16 GaultMillau points).

• Flawless Mise en Place: You organise your section with structure, precision, and a sharp eye for detail – from handling delicate raw produce and fresh herbs through to the final, immaculate presentation at the pass during service.

• Creative Input: You actively contribute your own ideas for seasonal cold dishes, plating concepts, and innovative culinary techniques to the kitchen brigade.

• Quality & Efficiency: You ensure a smooth service flow at the cold station and maintain exemplary hygiene, cold-chain, and HACCP standards at all times.

• Team Spirit & Mentorship: You provide inspiring leadership to Commis de Cuisine and apprentices on your section, fostering a respectful and encouraging work environment.

## This is you:
• Solid Foundation: Completed professional chef training and several years of experience in fine dining or luxury gastronomy, ideally with specific exposure to the gardemanger station.

• Passion for Produce: Deep knowledge of fresh raw ingredients, cold preparation techniques, and seasoning, paired with a strong commitment to premium quality and aesthetics.

• Precision under Pressure: A calm demeanor, composure, and sharp focus, even during peak service hours when timing is critical.

• Personality: High personal standards of quality, a true team-player mindset, resilience, and a genuine passion for high-end gastronomy.

• Languages: Must-Have: Italian. Ideally, good knowledge of English or German.
What You Can Expect from Us:
• Shape World-Class Gastronomy: Work within one of the most prestigious kitchen brigades in the Swiss Alps.

• Room for Growth: Tailored professional development opportunities and career advancement prospects within the Kulm Group.

• Attractive Living Environment: Work and live in the breathtaking mountain landscape of the Engadin, featuring attractive staff benefits and employee accommodation.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
Working in direct collaboration with the General Management, you bear overall responsibility for the Rooms Division and act as the driving force for quality and innovation:
• Strategic Leadership: You lead and inspire a team of approximately 80–120 employees through your direct reports (Front Office, Concierge, Reservations, Housekeeping, and Laundry).

• Guest Journey & Quality: You are responsible for the seamless implementation of Forbes and 5-star excellence standards. You don’t just analyze guest feedback; you transform it into tangible service innovations.

• Commercial Mindset: In close coordination with Revenue Management, Sales, and Marketing, you optimize occupancy and ADR. You are responsible for budget planning, forecasting, and cost control (labor and operating expenses) with a focus on maximum profitability.

• Process Pioneer: You drive digital transformation and optimize internal SOPs to minimize friction and maximize the time dedicated to the guest.

• Training: Constant training and continuous development of the teams.

• Host Mentality: You maintain a strong presence in the lobby, cultivate relationships with our discerning regular guests, and master complex complaint management with composure and charm.

## This is you
We are seeking an established leadership personality who thrives on complexity and views excellence as a way of life.
• Experience: You have completed a degree or vocational training in luxury hospitality and possess several years of leadership experience in a comparable position within the international 5-star hotel industry.

• Linguistic Proficiency: You are business fluent in both German and English. Due to our location and team structure, Italian is considered a very significant advantage.

• Coach & Mentor: You lead through inspiration rather than hierarchy. You find joy in developing talent and coaching fellow managers.

• Digital Affinity: You are confident in using modern PMS systems and have a passion for co-designing efficient digital processes.

• Demeanor: You embody the values of the Kulm Hotel—discreet, precise, resilient, and always acting as a natural role model.
Why the Kulm Group?
• Creative Freedom: A position of absolute trust with direct reporting to the General Manager and the opportunity to significantly shape the future of our properties, both humanly and professionally.

• Appreciation: An environment that values your experience in people management and gives you the space to establish modern, world-class leadership approaches.

• Exclusivity: Working at one of the world’s premier addresses within a team that places a high value on cohesion and mutual support.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

jobs.description:
Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-10-01.

Where historic charm meets modern luxury – Grand Hotel Kronenhof in Pontresina is one of the most renowned 5-star superior hotels in Switzerland. Overlooking the fascinating Engadin mountain scenery, we celebrate hospitality at the highest level. To perfectly present this magical place for our guests, we are looking for a personality who has cleanliness, elegance and leadership in their blood.

## This is what you move with us
As Executive Housekeeper, you are the driving force behind the impeccable appearance of our hotel. You report directly to the Rooms Division Manager and lead an international team of approximately 24 employees.

• Quality assurance at 5-star level: You ensure impeccable cleanliness and living quality in all guest rooms and public areas – always in line with the demanding standards of Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). You are also responsible for our staff accommodation.

• Inspiring leadership: You are a coach and role model for your team. You are responsible for staff scheduling, conduct training sessions (equipment and cleaning procedures), carry out performance reviews and are actively involved in the recruitment process of new talents.

• Efficient management & logistics: You manage inventory, oversee the purchasing of hotel linen and uniforms, and coordinate the smooth laundry process in close cooperation with our sister hotel, Kulm.

• Interface professional: You are in daily contact with the Executive Management, Engineering, Floristry and Front Office to ensure smooth housekeeping operations.

## This is you
• Your foundation: Completed vocational training in the hotel industry (Hotel Management Specialist) or a professional qualification in Housekeeping Management, ideally complemented by specific further training.

• Your experience: Several years of management experience in Housekeeping, preferably in the 5-star hotel industry. The position is suitable for both experienced managers and committed junior managers who are ready to take the next step in their career.

• Your language skills: Must-have: Fluent German or English. Advantageous: Knowledge of Italian and/or Portuguese.

• Your personality: You are characterised by a keen eye for detail, strong business acumen, excellent organisational skills and absolute discretion.

• Start date: From 1 October or by agreement.
What we offer:

• Affordable staff accommodation in Pontresina or Samedan.

• A workplace in one of the most beautiful locations in the Swiss Alps.

• Room for personal responsibility and extensive decision-making authority within your area.

• A motivated, interdisciplinary team and an excellent working environment in one of the top Swiss Deluxe Hotels.
Ready for the next step in your career? If you are ready for this challenge and would like to keep our Housekeeping team on the path to success, we look forward to receiving your comprehensive application.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/f/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Grigioni). Carico di lavoro: 100%. Contratto: Unbefristet / Permanente. Inizio: 2026-10-01.

Dove il fascino storico incontra il lusso moderno – il Grand Hotel Kronenhof di Pontresina è uno dei più famosi hotel 5 stelle superior in Svizzera. Affacciato sull'affascinante paesaggio montano Engadin, celebriamo l'ospitalità al massimo livello. Per presentare perfettamente questo luogo magico per i nostri ospiti, stiamo cercando una personalità che ha pulizia, eleganza e leadership nel loro sangue.

## Questo è ciò che si muove con noi
Come Executive Housekeeper, sei la forza trainante dietro l'aspetto impeccabile del nostro hotel. Si segnala direttamente al Rooms Division Manager e guida un team internazionale di circa 24 dipendenti.

• Garanzia di qualità a 5 stelle: garantisce una pulizia impeccabile e una qualità di vita in tutte le camere e aree pubbliche – sempre in linea con gli standard esigenti di Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes e Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). Siete anche responsabili per il nostro alloggio personale.

• Leader d'ispirazione: Sei un coach e un modello di ruolo per il tuo team. Siete responsabili della pianificazione del personale, delle sessioni di formazione di condurre (equipment e procedure di pulizia), delle recensioni sulle prestazioni e siete attivamente coinvolti nel processo di reclutamento di nuovi talenti.

• Gestione efficiente e logistica: gestisci l'inventario, sovrintende l'acquisto di biancheria d'albergo e uniformi, e coordina il processo di lavanderia liscio in stretta collaborazione con il nostro hotel sorella, Kulm.

• Interfaccia professionale: Lei è in contatto quotidiano con la Direzione Esecutivo, Ingegneria, Floristry e Front Office per garantire le operazioni di pulizia liscia.

## Sei tu.
• La vostra fondazione: Formazione professionale completa nel settore alberghiero (Hotel Management Specialist) o una qualifica professionale in Housekeeping Management, idealmente completato da specifica formazione ulteriore.

• La vostra esperienza: Diversi anni di esperienza di gestione in Housekeeping, preferibilmente nel settore alberghiero a 5 stelle. La posizione è adatta sia ai manager esperti che ai manager impegnati che sono pronti a compiere il prossimo passo nella loro carriera.

• Le tue competenze linguistiche: Must-have: Tedesco fluente o inglese. Vantaggio: Conoscenza dell'italiano e/o del portoghese.

• La vostra personalità: siete caratterizzati da un occhio attento ai dettagli, acume aziendale forte, eccellenti capacità organizzative e assoluta discrezione.

• Data d'inizio: dal 1 ottobre o d'accordo.
Cosa offriamo:

• Alloggio personale conveniente a Pontresina o Samedan.

• Un posto di lavoro in una delle località più belle delle Alpi svizzere.

• Sala per la responsabilità personale e l'ampio potere decisionale all'interno della vostra area.

• Un team motivato e interdisciplinare e un ambiente di lavoro eccellente in uno dei migliori hotel di lusso svizzeri.
Pronto per il prossimo passo nella tua carriera? Se siete pronti per questa sfida e volete mantenere il nostro team di pulizia sulla strada del successo, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione completa.

## Vantaggi
A Kulm Group, i nostri dipendenti sono il cuore del nostro successo. Offriamo interessanti opportunità di sviluppo, sistemazioni confortevoli, pasti convenienti nel ristorante del personale, e numerosi vantaggi.

Wo historischer Charme auf modernen Luxus trifft – das Grand Hotel Kronenhof in Pontresina ist eines der renommiertesten 5-Sterne-Superior-Hotels der Schweiz. Mit Blick auf die faszinierende Engadiner Berglandschaft feiern wir Gastfreundschaft auf höchstem Niveau. Um diesen magischen Ort für unsere Gäste perfekt zu präsentieren, suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Sauberkeit, Eleganz und Führung im Blut hat.

## Dies ist, was Sie mit uns bewegen
Als Executive Housekeeper sind Sie die treibende Kraft hinter dem makellosen Erscheinungsbild unseres Hotels. Sie berichten direkt an den Rooms Division Manager und führen ein internationales Team von rund 24 Mitarbeitern.

• Qualitätssicherung auf 5-Sterne-Niveau: Sie sorgen für einwandfreie Sauberkeit und Wohnqualität in allen Gästezimmern und öffentlichen Bereichen – immer nach den anspruchsvollen Standards von Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes und Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). Sie sind auch für unsere Personalunterkunft verantwortlich.

• Inspirierende Führung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild für dein Team. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Personalplanung, führen Schulungen (Geräte- und Reinigungsverfahren) durch, führen Leistungsüberprüfungen durch und sind aktiv in den Rekrutierungsprozess neuer Talente eingebunden.

• Effizientes Management & Logistik: Sie verwalten den Bestand, betreuen den Einkauf von Hotelwäsche und Uniformen und koordinieren den reibungslosen Wäscheprozess in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Schwesterhotel Kulm.

• Interface Professional: Sie stehen im täglichen Kontakt mit dem Executive Management, Engineering, Floristry und Front Office, um einen reibungslosen Betrieb im Haushalt zu gewährleisten.

## Das bist du
• Ihre Stiftung: Absolvierte Berufsausbildung in der Hotellerie (Hotel Management Specialist) oder eine berufliche Qualifikation im Housekeeping Management, ideal ergänzt durch eine spezifische Weiterbildung.

• Ihre Erfahrung: Mehrjährige Managementerfahrung im Housekeeping, vorzugsweise in der 5-Sterne-Hotellerie. Die Position eignet sich sowohl für erfahrene Manager als auch für engagierte Junior Manager, die bereit sind, den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere zu gehen.

• Ihre Sprachkenntnisse: Must-have: fließend Deutsch oder Englisch. Vorteile: Italienisch und/oder Portugiesisch.

• Ihre Persönlichkeit: Sie zeichnen sich durch ein scharfes Auge für Details, starken Geschäftssinn, ausgezeichnete organisatorische Fähigkeiten und absolute Diskretion aus.

• Startdatum: Ab 1. Oktober oder nach Vereinbarung.
Was wir anbieten:

• Erschwingliche Personalunterkunft in Pontresina oder Samedan.

• Ein Arbeitsplatz an einem der schönsten Orte der Schweizer Alpen.

• Raum für persönliche Verantwortung und umfangreiche Entscheidungsbefugnisse in Ihrer Region.

• Ein motiviertes, interdisziplinäres Team und ein exzellentes Arbeitsumfeld in einem der besten Schweizer Deluxe Hotels.
Bereit für den nächsten Schritt in Ihrer Karriere? Wenn Sie für diese Herausforderung bereit sind und unser Housekeeping-Team auf dem Weg zum Erfolg halten möchten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre umfassende Bewerbung.

## Vorteile
Bei der Kulm Group stehen unsere Mitarbeiter im Mittelpunkt unseres Erfolgs. Wir bieten attraktive Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, komfortable Unterkünfte, erschwingliche Mahlzeiten im Personalrestaurant und zahlreiche Vergünstigungen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Directeur exécutif du ménage (h/f/d) — Grand Hôtel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Charge de travail: 100%. Contrat: Unbefristet / Permanent. Début: 2026-10-01.

Où le charme historique rencontre le luxe moderne – le Grand Hotel Kronenhof de Pontresina est l'un des hôtels 5 étoiles les plus renommés de Suisse. Surplombant le paysage fascinant de la montagne Engadin, nous célébrons l'hospitalité au plus haut niveau. Pour présenter parfaitement cet endroit magique pour nos invités, nous cherchons une personnalité qui a la propreté, l'élégance et le leadership dans leur sang.

## C'est ce que tu déménages avec nous.
En tant que chef de ménage, vous êtes la force motrice derrière l'apparence impeccable de notre hôtel. Vous rendez compte directement au gestionnaire de la Division des salles et dirigez une équipe internationale d'environ 24 employés.

• Assurance qualité au niveau 5 étoiles: Vous garantissez une propreté et une qualité de vie impeccables dans toutes les chambres et tous les espaces publics – toujours en conformité avec les normes exigeantes des Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes et Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). Vous êtes également responsable de notre hébergement personnel.
